title: Welcome to Mingus Football
summary: Fantasy rankings, matchups and NFL lines in one place. Here's what's on the site so far.
body: Mingus Football pulls NFL stats, schedules, injuries and Vegas lines from nflverse every week. Use Weekly Rankings to sort every position by fantasy points per game in your league's scoring, open any game for a head-to-head breakdown with betting trends and matchup edges, and check the Player Database for game logs. More to come.
